about.en: SIS is the governance and staking token of Symbiosis, a cross-chain liquidity protocol that swaps and bridges tokens between EVM networks and non-EVM chains such as Bitcoin, Solana and TRON. It is the ERC-20 at 0xd38BB40815d2B0c2d2c866e0c72c5728ffC76dd9 on Ethereum, with deployments on BNB Chain (0xF98b660AdF2ed7d9d9D9dAACC2fb0CAce4F21835), Arbitrum, zkSync Era, Linea and Scroll.
